svg.text: LDS padding: what pad_interval and pad_amount buy you
every row starts in the same bank
one DWORD of padding skews each row
Both fields are encoded, not literal: pad_interval 0 → 2 DWORDs, 1 → 4, … 7 → 256 · pad_amount 0 → 1 DWORD, 1 → 2, … 127 → 128
They must both be zero or both be non-zero. Padding is memory → LDS only; there is no de-padding on the way out.
It is expressed in DWORDs while every other field is in data_size elements, and tile_dim0 must be a multiple of 4 bytes.
